issue.title: Retire admin_center_launch_subtab
issue.description: Expose Launch as a guarded Admin Center Config sub-tab and route Launch Control openers to it.

task_type_fields.remove_when: Behavioral parity, busy-write safety, status refresh, responsive visuals, navigation, and full verification pass.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Config retains its current five children and every Launch Control opener pushes the standalone ModelsPanel.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Config exposes Launch and every Launch Control opener selects Config > Launch.

payload.entry: Verified admin_center_launch_subtab is absent from the feature-flag registry and config schema, its disabled standalone production branch is removed, all production Launch openers now route unconditionally to Admin Center Config > Launch, tools/check_feature_flags reports only this live-bead warning before closure, and focused enabled-route plus Config Launch visual coverage passes.
